title: Chicken Rezala
subtitle: A Bengali white korma of chicken in a cardamom and cream sauce
excerpt: Bone-in chicken cooked in a pale, fragrant sauce of yoghurt, cardamom and ground almonds. A Mughal-influenced dish from Kolkata's Awadhi kitchen tradition.
sourceNotes: Rezala is a classic Kolkata Muslim wedding dish; this version draws on Bengali and Awadhi sources and uses boneless thighs for ease.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze in portions for up to three months. Defrost overnight and reheat gently over a low heat, adding a splash of water.
recipe.batchNotes: Double the quantity easily; use a wider pan so the chicken is not crowded when browning.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: The curry tastes better the next day. Cook fully, cool and refrigerate. Reheat gently before serving.

content.text: Rezala is a white curry: no tomatoes, no browning, no chilli heat. The sauce is built on yoghurt, ground almonds and whole spices. Keep the heat low throughout so the yoghurt does not curdle.
Mix the chicken with the yoghurt, garlic paste, ginger paste, white pepper and salt. Cover and leave in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Heat the ghee in a wide saucepan over a medium heat. Add the cardamom, cloves and cinnamon. Fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the onion and cook over a low to medium heat for 15 minutes, stirring often, until soft and pale gold.
Add the marinated chicken with all its marinade. Stir gently to coat. Cook over a low heat for five minutes, stirring often.
Stir in the ground almonds. Add 150ml of water. Cover and simmer gently for 25 minutes, stirring every five minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the cream and rose water, if using. Simmer uncovered for three minutes. Taste and adjust salt.
Scatter over fresh coriander and serve with rice or naan.

items.symptom: The yoghurt has curdled and the sauce looks grainy.
items.cause: The heat was too high when the chicken went in.
items.fix: Always keep the heat low when cooking with yoghurt. Add a splash of water and stir vigorously; the sauce often comes back together.

items.cause: The chicken released a lot of water during cooking.
items.fix: Remove the lid and simmer briskly for five minutes to reduce. Stir in an extra tablespoon of ground almonds to thicken.

items.symptom: The dish lacks depth of flavour.
items.cause: The onions were not cooked long enough.
items.fix: Rezala onions need 15 minutes minimum at a steady low heat. They should be very soft and just turning gold.
